notes.title: Steam Autumn Sale
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32022095/1fa6df39606d6c6e7315e188fcbab8935fa836f2.gif[/img]

Heads up raiders, 

Autumn sale event is live! 

To celebrate the upcoming festive season, retro-inspired interstellar shoot’n’loot RiftStar Raiders will be on sale with 70% off as a part of Autumn sale event across Steam.

With a build-your-own-class system, you’ll be dropping hordes of enemies and picking them clean to design your own ship from the ground up. Weapons, shields, boosters, skins and more, you’ll have the freedom to create an agile sharpshooter, a heavy-hitting tank or anything in between. 

Choose your favourite perks to determine your own playstyle and race through each challenge with new tactics - killing more, looting more, and building more.

From 20th until 26th November, you can pick up RiftStar Raiders for only €5.99 / $5.99 / £4.79 - keep your eyes out for more upcoming sales before Christmas

notes.title: RiftStar Raiders Shortlisted in TIGA Awards - 30% off until 4th October!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32022095/de5449d30bf18f343d9268e7624fa50ac7f3c0a2.png[/img]

We’re extremely proud to announce that RiftStar Raiders has been shortlisted for both the Best Arcade Game and Best Visual Design at the TIGA Awards, and we’ll be celebrating with [b][u]30% off until 4th October![/u][/b]

The TIGA Awards brings together one of the world’s largest networks of indie game studios, developers and publishers to celebrate the very best the games industry has to offer. With hundreds of entries from all over the world, RiftStar Raiders has been shortlisted against other huge names such as Cuphead and God of War to potentially take home the prize for Best Arcade game and Best Visual Design.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32022095/1afc0260ecd7ea06246c8dc8eab136be3c39ad37.jpg[/img]

We never would have had this opportunity if it wasn’t for the players supporting us and enjoying our game, so to celebrate we’re offering 30% off RiftStar Raiders on Steam until 4th October.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32022095/a67c8cf768bba225804444c52e4f4b203be5f877.jpg[/img]


[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/462630/RiftStar_Raiders/] BUY RIFTSTAR RAIDERS NOW[/url][/h1]

With millions of potential combinations, RiftStar Raiders challenges you to create your own class with custom loadouts. From a tank, to a medic, to a stealthy dps build, loot enemies to create a ship bespoke to your play style and strategy.

notes.title: Free Trial Version Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32022095/558765e27bfb52b11d8031edce63b90758c6e83b.png[/img]

Play RiftStar Raiders for free in our trial version! 

With the trial live now, you can download and start dropping enemies like flies, stocking up on loot across 2 story missions in this top down, twin-stick shoot-em-up.

Upgrade to the full version of the game and you’ll keep all the weapons, gear and perks you farmed in loot ready to be put to the test in brand new events. Strategise with millions of potential ship customisation combinations to take on battles in new and unique ways every time.

Raid together in teams of up to 4 to strategise and overcome challenges, obstacles and overwhleming battles together. Horde that loot, rebuild and reinvent your ship to experience each level in a whole new way.

Interested? Download our free trial now to get started!
